sell.rationale: Somewhat bearish outlook; weakest forward return expectation in the Financials cohort. The dividend yield, while solid, does not compensate for the negative momentum.

buy.rationale: Bullish outlook; trading at 18% discount to 5-year P/BV average with a 5.1% yield. The US regulatory overhang is bounded and the risk/reward is asymmetric to the upside.

rebalance_suggestions.rationale: Highest-conviction bullish outlook in the portfolio; currently underweight relative to conviction level. Infrastructure super-cycle tailwind is durable and backlog visibility is exceptional.
